document.abstract: Especially adaptable to instrumentation needs, for long or short runs of consistent quality, the transportable Type T246 Mark 3 Automatic Tri-Film Processor offers automatic programming, ready adaption to various processing techniques, automatic and leaderless loop formation, combined with a small size. The machine may be adjusted simply, in a few minutes, to process and dry four tracks of 16mm, two of 35mm or one of 70mm film at speeds up to 6 ft/min.
